name: OMB Memorandum M-25-21: Accelerating Federal Use of AI
update_frequency: One-time memorandum with later implementation updates
known_limitations: The memorandum sets executive-branch policy and agency requirements. It does not establish that an agency has deployed an AI system effectively, measured benefits, completed risk controls, or achieved public-trust outcomes.

automation_notes: Monitor implementing agency policies, inventories, waivers, and later OMB amendments or rescissions.
